# jumpcloud_password_policy (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud password policy by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_password_policy" "example" {
  name = "Strong Password Policy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the password policy. Exactly one of id or name must be specified.
- `name` (String) The name of the password policy. Exactly one of id or name must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `enable_max_login_attempts` (Boolean) Whether login attempt limiting is enabled.
- `enable_min_length` (Boolean) Whether minimum length enforcement is enabled.
- `lockout_time_in_seconds` (Number) Duration of account lockout in seconds.
- `max_login_attempts` (Number) Number of failed attempts before account lockout.
- `min_length` (Number) Minimum password length.
- `needs_lowercase` (Boolean) Whether the password must contain lowercase characters.
- `needs_numeric` (Boolean) Whether the password must contain numeric characters.
- `needs_symbolic` (Boolean) Whether the password must contain special characters.
- `needs_uppercase` (Boolean) Whether the password must contain uppercase characters.
- `password_expiration_in_days` (Number) Number of days until the password expires.
- `precedence` (Number) Priority when multiple policies apply.
